evaluation.name: prism_eval
evaluation.description: 10 read-only questions exercising Prism MCP read tools

question.prompt: What IRIS version is running? Use the get_server_info tool.
question.assertion: Return value contains a non-empty "version" string.

question.prompt: List the available namespaces on the IRIS server.
question.assertion: Return value contains a "namespaces" list with at least one entry.

question.prompt: List up to 10 source documents on the server.
question.assertion: Return value contains a "documents" list (may be empty if no docs exist).

question.prompt: List all class documents (type 'cls') on the server.
question.assertion: Return value contains a "documents" list; every entry has type "CLS" or the list is empty.

question.prompt: Run a SELECT query that returns a single row: select 1 as One.
question.assertion: Return value contains a "rows" list with one row, whose "One" column equals 1.

question.prompt: How many rows are in the %Schema.GlobalInfo table? Use execute_sql.
question.assertion: Return value contains a numeric "count" field (the API may return it as 0 for SELECTs; rows[0].cnt is the real count).

question.prompt: Are there any %UnitTest.TestCase classes on this server?
question.assertion: Return value contains a "classes" list (may be empty if no test classes are compiled).

question.prompt: Show the 5 most recent test runs.
question.assertion: Return value contains a "runs" list with at most 5 entries.
